provenance.rationale: Composes the assigned route heading from the Guatape and El Penol Word section and the following Cartagena flight.

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Depart for Guatapé, one of Colombia’s most colourful and picturesque towns, known for its beautifully decorated façades and distinctive zócalos, traditional bas-relief panels depicting scenes from local life and culture. Continue to El Peñol Rock (La Piedra del Peñol), one of Antioquia’s most iconic natural landmarks. Rising nearly 220 metres above the surrounding landscape, the granite monolith offers panoramic views across a vast mosaic of lakes and islands.

Afterwards, enjoy a leisurely stroll through Guatapé, taking in its colourful architecture, traditional details and lively lakeside atmosphere before returning to Medellín.

Private guide and transfers · Guatapé and El Peñol · Breakfast

Breakfast at the hotel. After breakfast, private transfer to the airport with your driver for your flight to Cartagena de Indias, one of the best-preserved colonial cities in the Americas and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Upon arrival at Rafael Núñez International Airport, you will be welcomed by your private English-speaking guide, who will accompany you throughout your stay in Cartagena.

Not included: Flight Medellín – Cartagena
